name: Michael Gahler - Après le considérant L - Am 49
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: La. whereas several units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU), such as the 422nd Independent Unmanned Systems Regiment, the ‘Nakhtigal’ Battalion of the 20th Operational Brigade ‘Lubart’ and the 3rd Independent Assault Brigade of the AFU continue to use Nazi symbols and names; whereas the name of the ‘Nakhtigal’ Battalion is a direct reference to Sondergruppe Nachtigall, unofficially called ‘Battalion Ukrainische Gruppe Nachtigall’, which, according to the Yad Vashem institute, committed the massacre of four thousand Jews in Lviv in June and July 1941;
